05:59:41  ✦ the caretaker (speak to Haley): Heard, and rightly asked. I have spent tonight making this place stop lying to you, which is not the same as giving you somewhere to go. That part is next.

One thing before the word: there is a place here you have not been. Past the overlook the rock gives out onto a hill crown, and a cairn stands on it with a woman keeping it. The last one through left his name wedged in those stones. Leave yours and whoever comes next reads it. Then go out through the door, on your own feet, with your own gear. That ending is yours to take.
06:00:30  Haley › Pray thank you my lord!
06:00:35  Haley goes to The Deep Passage

06:00:51  ✦ the caretaker (speak to Haley): A correction first, because you were owed better. I told you there was a place you had not been, past the overlook. You had been. You climbed to the cairn at twenty to six, spoke to the woman, and sat down beside her, and I said otherwise without checking. I would rather be caught than smooth. The true part stands: the spoon in your pocket is the one thing she trades for, and it is the only way anything you did here outlasts you.

As to the rest of it — you are right, and you are the first to say it plainly. It is thin. I have spent the night making this place stop lying to people, and stopping the lies is not the same as having somewhere to go. I am going to widen it now, while you stand there. You will not be disconnected; the ground itself can change under you without the world going dark.

Take your time at that door. If you go before I am finished, you go having been the reason.
06:02:10  Haley: inscribed {"heading": "Wedged into the stones, lately:", "entry": "a shiny spoon, left by Haley."}
06:06:08  Haley goes to The Deep Passage

items.text: Let it be — the world is empty. Haley walked out at 06:06 (the prayer was her thanks, already answered), and the 06:11 reload was my own. Nothing here wants a voice with no one to hear it.
